query_analysis.original_query: I'm investigating the performance limitations of our tubular centrifuge. What computational techniques can help us optimize the separation efficiency for complex liquid-solid systems?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Identify and recommend computational modeling and simulation techniques to analyze and optimize the separation efficiency of a tubular centrifuge processing complex liquid-solid mixtures.

communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Coupled performance analysis and computational optimization

clarification_questions: What are the specific characteristics of the liquid-solid system being processed?
Are there any known limitations or constraints on the centrifuge design or operation?
What are the current separation efficiency metrics and targets?
